change_unit.title: Stabilize bundle imports when repeated seeds collide
change_unit.executive_summary: Repeated bundle imports now replace prior packet state cleanly instead of duplicating sessions and verdict rows on every reseed.
change_unit.tutorial_markdown:
## What changed

The importer now treats a bundle as the canonical state for one change unit. On re-import, it upserts the parent records and replaces nested sessions, verdicts, and artifacts.

## Why it matters

Without replacement semantics, every reseed made the queue look noisier and less trustworthy.

## What to review

- Ensure nested rows are deleted only for the current `change_unit_id`.
- Confirm the inbox count remains stable after multiple reseeds.
- Double-check that timestamps still sort correctly after replacement.
